name: yappp.
description: A web + mobile voice chat that pairs strangers in a FIFO queue and hands off to peer-to-peer WebRTC audio.
highlights: P2P audio via WebRTC — the server is signaling-only.
FIFO matchmaking which ensures a user never re-pairs the same user.

name: Beatam Noctem
tagline: tickets, voting & check-in for one event
description: An event web app where attendees never make an account — tickets are delivered by email + SMS with QR codes, scanned at the door by admins. There's also a voting system for award nominees and an admin dashboard for check-in, audit logs, and analytics.
highlights: Account-less ticketing: QR-coded PDFs delivered via email and SMS.
Award voting with per-email uniqueness and Paystack webhooks for paid orders.

name: ShuttleApp
tagline: live campus shuttle tracking for KNUST
description: An installable PWA that tracks KNUST campus shuttles live on a map, so students know exactly when to head out instead of guessing at a bus stop.
highlights: Live shuttle positions on a map, edge-to-edge on iOS with a translucent status bar.
Installable as a home-screen app with a manifest and offline-friendly shell.

name: Lucy's Perfumery
description: An e-commerce storefront for original perfumes, diffusers, and body splashes — browse by brand and category, with a full checkout flow.
highlights: Catalog browsing by brand and category with a fast SPA storefront.
Deployed on Vercel with a custom domain and OG-ready product pages.

name: Mula DataHub
tagline: live Ghana Stock Exchange data & disclosures
description: A data platform tracking live GSE prices, annual and quarterly reports, public notices, and Ghana business news from major local publishers. Currently building out the backend.
highlights: Live GSE price tracking alongside company disclosures and reports.
Aggregates Ghana business news headlines from major local publishers.
